page.layout: One column of text on a single printed page; running head at top with page number at top left; catchword-like final word "undi-" at the lower right is a line-end hyphenated word, not a catchword. No margin notes.

main_text.p: regionibus sint dispersæ, & tum ex insidiis Pontificiis, tum per controversias & discordias intestinas, jam nunc fere undique, & quidem maxime periclitentur, quæ ratio inveniri possit, ut revelata nobis divini verbi veritas ab iis dissensionibus & insidiarum procellis eximi, Electori quoque Coloniensi Turcæ sepe jam nunc fere propter agnitam veritatem bello suppresso subvenisse, & pax & concordia in nostris Ecclesiis restitui & stabiliri possit.

In secundo Capite Regia sua Majestas, de salute publica Patriæ solicitatur, rationes & consilium quæ sens qualiter turbæ & simultates Gallicæ, propter Religionis diversitatem potissimum exortæ, sopiri & antiqua pax & fides in toto Regno recolligi & stabiliri possit.
Ad primum quod attinet, experientia, proh Deum! satis abundè testatur, navicula Christi, in nostris Ecclesiis, procellis hostium, & intestinis quoque infestationibus undi-

page.notes: Heavily worn black-letter-like italic and blurred roman type; several words are doubtful, especially in the lines "Turck sefo", "fere", "agnitam", "Gallice" and "Regno", which are transcribed from a poor scan and may be inexact. Greek or Hebrew: none.
